query:
UPDATE uploadsessions
               SET type = $2::text::upload_session_type,
                   createat = $3,
                   userid = $4,
                   channelid = $5,
                   filename = $6,
                   path = $7,
                   filesize = $8,
                   fileoffset = $9,
                   remoteid = $10,
                   reqfileid = $11
             WHERE id = $1
